headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Grants JPMorgan Preliminary Merchant Bank Licence
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria has granted JPMorgan a preliminary licence to establish a merchant bank following a $38 million deposit.
why: Banking licenses enable major international financial institutions to expand their operations, corporate lending, and advisory services within emerging frontier markets.

impacts.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
impacts.why: Establishing a new merchant bank expands institutional presence in West Africa, though capital allocation is modest relative to the firm's global balance sheet.
